author.name: MAPLE OpenSource License for Minors
author.biography: We are creating the world's first SPDX-indexable open source software license dedicated to protecting the intellectual property of minors. By @OpenRockets

posts.caption:
A 14-year-old can write the code. Own the copyright. Publish the project. And still disappear from the legal record when an adult has to sign.

That is the riddle behind MAPLE 1.0: preserve the minor as author while legal capacity is handled separately.

posts.caption:
There are about 2,000,000,000 kids on the planet.
At age 5, 98% of children scored at the "creative genius" level. 

At age 10, the number dropped to 30%.
At age 15, it fell to 12%.
Among over 1M+ adults tested, only 2% had high creative capacities.
